items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: Oh, yeah. Yeah. I recall when I used to go out with him, sometimes, we'd stay up all night, jamming.

ctx.x: Can you remember -- I can remember when he first came. I remember the first trip he took in the bus. I mean, he was such a little guy, and it was a funny thing for him to fall in that band and fall on his feet and everything, right?
Oh, yeah. Yeah. I recall when I used to go out with him, sometimes, we'd stay up all night, jamming.
